274: // validate performs validation on the input policy.
275: func (i *InputsPolicy) validate() error {
276: 	if i.Source == nil {
277: 		return nil
278: 	}
279: 
280: 	switch source := i.Source.(type) {
281: 	// If the source is a scoped account, it must have a non-empty
282: 	// account name.
283: 	case *ScopedAccount:
284: 		if source.AccountName == "" {
285: 			return ErrMissingAccountName
286: 		}
287: 
288: 	// If the source is a list of UTXOs, it must not be empty and
289: 	// must not contain duplicates.
290: 	case *CoinSourceUTXOs:
291: 		return validateUTXOs(source.UTXOs)
292: 	// Any other source type is unsupported.
293: 	default:
294: 		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %T",
295: 			ErrUnsupportedCoinSource, source)
296: 	}
297: 
298: 	return nil
299: }
